avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction decreases quetiapine levels, reducing antipsychotic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support supplement if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; may impair motor function

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may increase quetiapine concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Limit intake; monitor for increased side effects (sedation, orthostasis)

caution_supplements.name: SAM-e
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive serotonergic effects; theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor mood and neurological symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases quetiapine bioavailability and serum levels

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase quetiapine absorption and peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain routine for steady-state levels

monitoring_notes: Monitor for CNS depression, orthostatic hypotension, and metabolic effects (weight, glucose, lipids). Counsel patients to maintain consistent dosing schedule and report breakthrough psychiatric symptoms or excessive sedation.
